rooms.name: Somewhere in the Void
rooms.desc:
You float in nothingness - or perhaps stand on nothingness, which is
firm beneath your feet. All is dark, except for the glowing portals that
lie in the cardinal directions.

rooms.name: A Secluded Grove
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the middle of a grove of strange, and possibly
magical trees which climb into the sky all around you. In the middle
of the grove, you can see a strange grass with a blueish tinge. It's 
hard to see anything beyond the trees of the grove.
